composition_summary: Offline full-v3 export mode. The requested class-21 recipe-transfer-08 payload is not supported by the current sink: it accepts name/description/trigger/steps/prior_knowledge_content/intent_examples but drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry, and it cannot preserve the persisted knowledge/stepnumber/type=component/include schema, tool_bindings, dependencies, variant step_link and variable_patterns that a full v3 Recipe requires. The exact v3 constructor (step_descriptions with one component step per UUID, variants with step_link, dependency_registry) cannot be emitted into the supported class-21 payload, so no class-21 entry is proposed. The requested class-22 pure-logic draft d14b7a42-2c12-57e8-9cf1-59d7e576182a (result = {'state': 'Idle'}, zero inputs, no dependencies) is a supported constructor with no referenced Tool or component, so it is proposed as an unapproved draft; insertion allocates its identity and Q1/human Q2 follow. It is not activated and grants no dispatch permission. The subworkflow returns state data only and never posts a user message.
